zh: 休士顿大学（，缩写UH）是美国德州一所研究型大学，也是休斯顿大学系统的旗舰学府. 1927年3月7日创立，截至2019年底有超过46000名在学学生(德州第三大大学)，其中研究所硕士及博士生占近7900名. 校园占地667英亩（约270公顷），位于休士顿市区东南方，1983年至1991年被称为休士顿大学-大学公园校区. 卡内基学术基金会将休士顿大学评为具有最高研究活动的博士学位授予机构之一. 2021年《美国新闻与世界报导》在全美大学排名中排名第133位，在公立大学中排名第70位，全球排名在ARWU排名世界前三百大之列. 休大选才多元, 且照顾有色人种学生及经济弱势学生, 有近9%学生是来自全球130个国家, 每年投入学术研究经费2.4亿美元.

该大学通过其16所学院提供260个学位课程, 包括商学、建筑、法律、验光学和药学专业学位课程. 该校每年运用预算资金进行2.01亿美元的各领域研究，并在校园内运营著35个研究中心和研究所. 跨学科研究包括有超导体研究、太空商业化开发和太空探索、生物医学科学和工程、能源和自然资源以及人工智能(AI). UH的校友基数每年9,000人的速度成长，总数超过31万名校友. 该大学毕业生的经济响力每年为美国经济贡献超过64亿美元，同时为国家创造约62,000个就业机会.
休士顿大学开始于休士顿初级学院（HJC）. 1927年3月7日，休士顿独立学区（HISD）教育委员会的委员一致通过了一项授权建立和经营大学院校的决议， 大学院校由HISD负责经营管理. 同年从莱斯大学、德州大学等延揽12位教师，录取232名学生开始授课.
1933年10月，德克萨斯州州长米里亚姆·弗格森（Miriam A. Ferguson）将美国众议院第194号法案签署通过，使该学院具备转型成大学的资格. 1934年4月30日，HISD的教育委员会通过了一项决议，使学校成为一所为期四年的学院，休士顿学院正式更名为休士顿大学.
UH发展开为一个四年制的大学机构，始于1934年6月4日，在San Jacinto高中，注册人数为682人. 1934年，休士顿大学的第一个校区成立于Milam街和McGowen街的第二浸信会教堂. 在隔年秋天，校园搬到了Main Street的南方主浸信会教堂 - 位在里士满大道和鹰街之间 - 并在那里营运了五年. 1935年5月，休士顿大学在米勒户外剧场举行了第一次毕业典礼.
en: The University of Houston is a public research university in Houston, Texas, United States. It was established in 1927 as Houston Junior College, a coeducational institution and one of multiple junior colleges formed in the first decades of the 20th century. In 1934, HJC was restructured as a four-year degree-granting institution and renamed University of Houston. In 1977, it became the founding member of the University of Houston System. Today, Houston is the fourth-largest university in Texas, awarding 11,773 degrees for the 2024-2025 academic year. As of 2024, it has a worldwide alumni base of 331,672.

The university consists of fifteen colleges and an interdisciplinary honors college offering 310 degree programs and enrolls approximately 40,000 undergraduate and 9,000 graduate students. The university's campus, which is primarily in southeast Houston, spans 894 acre, with the inclusion of its two instructional sites located in Sugar Land and Katy. The university is also the founding campus of the University of Houston System.

The university is classified among "R1: Doctoral Universities – Very high research activity" and spends approximately $240 million annually in research. The university operates more than 35 research centers and institutes on campus in areas such as superconductivity, space commercialization and exploration, biomedical sciences and engineering, energy and natural resources, and artificial intelligence.

The university has more than 500 student organizations and 17 intercollegiate sports teams. Its varsity athletic teams, known as the Houston Cougars, are members of the Big 12 Conference and compete in the NCAA Division I in all sports. In 2021, the university received and accepted an invitation to join the Big 12 Conference. The football team regularly makes bowl game appearances and the men's basketball team has made 26 appearances in the NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament, including eight Elite Eight and Final Four appearances. The men's golf team has won 16 national championships, the most in NCAA history. In 2022, UH's men's track and field team earned its seventh Indoor Conference Championship title and its swimming and diving team defended its American Athletic Conference title for the sixth straight season.

The University of Houston began as Houston Junior College (HJC). On March 7, 1927, trustees of the Board of Education of the Houston Independent School District (HISD) unanimously signed a charter founding the junior college. The junior college was operated and administered by HISD.
